prompt: Employee.java is provided and complete. Use the Stream API in Analytics.java to average salaries per department into a TreeMap, list names by salary descending, and find the highest paid person in one department as an Optional.
explanation: Each method is one stream pipeline. Collectors.groupingBy takes an optional map factory, so passing TreeMap::new as the middle argument gives a sorted map instead of the default HashMap, and Collectors.averagingDouble is the downstream collector that turns each group into one number. The sorting method chains Comparator.comparingDouble(...).reversed().thenComparing(...) -- note that reversed() must come before thenComparing, or the tie-break would be reversed too. max() returns an Optional precisely because a filtered stream can be empty, which removes the need for a null check.
hints: For the name list, sort the Employee objects FIRST and only .map(Employee::getName) at the end -- once you map to names the salaries are gone.
highestPaidIn filters the stream down to the requested department and then asks max for the biggest by salary; max already hands you the Optional, so return it directly.
